problem: Alon-Boppana spectral bound for d-regular graphs
surface_leak: A spectral/interlacing bound of 2 sqrt(d-1) looks like the kind of eigenvalue loss case 1 removed.
why_negative: Ramanujan graphs achieve the Alon-Boppana bound, so 2 sqrt(d-1) is attained and no auxiliary object improves it. The matched positive is case 1, where a signed adjacency matrix DID.

sources.cite: Alon-Boppana: lambda_2 >= 2 sqrt(d-1) - O(1/log^2 n). Lubotzky-Phillips-Sarnak and independently Margulis construct Ramanujan families attaining lambda <= 2 sqrt(d-1), so the bound is essentially tight.
